% A guard: cases the fix must not break. zref-xr reads the URL of another
% document's PDF itself, and tex4ht does not hook it. Its starred form
% imports the labels of an .aux that LaTeX wrote. The page builds, and a
% reference to one prints its number and page as in the PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{hyperref}
\usepackage{zref-xr,zref-user}
\zexternaldocument*[Z-]{test-xr/latex}[https://example.org/ext.pdf]
\begin{document}
CaseZ \zref{Z-ss}, page \zpageref{Z-front}.

\section{Here}\label{here}
Local \ref{here}.
\end{document}
